issues.issue: beginning_cash/ending_cash use the line 3/28 subtotals, which include investments, and beginning_investments/ending_investments (15,970.80 / 16,352.79) are filled as well. The rules say investments are informational and not added to cash, so anything that adds the two together will count them twice. Using the subtotal is needed for the roll-forward to work.

issues.on_page: Local Receipts: Other 831.72 (General 381.99, Street 18.06, Companion Savings 431.67)
issues.issue: General's 381.99 exactly equals the CD's growth (16,352.79 - 15,970.80). It is almost certainly interest, i.e. investment income. 'other' is 16.6% of receipts.
